descFull: Media player engine for iOS, tvOS, macOS and visionOS. FFmpeg demux, VideoToolbox / dav1d / libavcodec decode, live TV with DVR timeshift and hardware deinterlace, Dolby Atmos passthrough, lossless TrueHD and DTS:X height channels, HDR10 / HDR10+ / Dolby Vision / HLG, text + bitmap + teletext subtitles, and an audio-only path. You ship the UI.
